article.story: NEW YORK -- — Josh Pratt’s 14 points helped Columbia defeat SUNY-Old Westbury 120-58 on Thursday. Pratt shot 4 for 6 (2 for 4 from 3-point range) and 4 of 4 from the free-throw line for the Lions (1-1). Douglas Langford scored 13 points and added nine rebounds, while Connor Igoe shot 4 of 4 from the field and 4 of 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 12 points. Imole Akinwale led the Panthers in scoring, finishing with 11 points. Up next Columbia hosts Stonehill in its next matchup on Monday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
